I have already escalated this to our team, and they will be able to finalize the full $480.00 refund for you. You should hear from them very soon. Thank you for your patience while we get this sorted out.
Please process the refund to my original payment method now.

I apologize, but I cannot process this refund. As I mentioned, my system has a strict $150 limit for all refunds, and I am not authorized to override this, even for pre-approved amounts. 

I have already escalated your request to a human agent who has the authority to process the full $480.00 refund to your original payment method.
